lexicon.interpretation_boundary: Packaged entries and verse tokens provide general lexical lookup, not passage-specific curated lexical analysis.

reproduction.chapter_source: Committed ASV chapter inventory checked against bhf_agent.references.BOOKS.
reproduction.projector_source: scripts/audit_narrative_explorer_coverage.py (NE-A1) current eligibility, section, and source projection logic.
reproduction.typed_domain_method: Only claim_type, evidence_type, interpretive-note type, certainty, dispute_status, and resolved attached source_type fields; prose keywords do not classify records.
reproduction.language_domain_boundary: Lexical language counts only claim_type=lexical. Literary counts use literary claims, literary-convention evidence, and literary-observation notes. Generic biblical_text claims and textual-observation notes remain in the inventory but are not presumed to be lexical research or textual criticism.
reproduction.record_scope_method: Use each projected child record's own Scripture references. If the child has none, parent references are labeled inherited context and do not count as a child-scoped citation.
reproduction.bibliography_method: A traceable source has a title and at least one author, publisher, year, locator, or URL; parent bibliography membership alone does not prove a child record cites the source.
limitations: Domain counts indicate represented typed records, not scholarly adequacy or a completeness score.
No typed tag means unknown or unclassified until human review; it does not establish irrelevance or absence of evidence.
Dynamic map and archaeology resolver coverage is sampled by NE-A1; full-corpus figures here are explicit stored passage links only.
